jobs.description:
Job Classification:
Investment Management - Investments

A GLOBAL FIRM WITH A DIVERSE & INCLUSIVE CULTURE
As the Global Asset Management business of Prudential, we’re always looking for ways to improve financial services. We’re passionate about making a meaningful impact - touching the lives of millions and solving financial challenges in an ever-changing world.

We also believe talent is key to achieving our vision and are intentional about building a culture on respect and collaboration. When you join PGIM, you’ll unlock a motivating and impactful career – all while growing your skills and advancing your profession at one of the world’s leading global asset managers!
If you’re not afraid to think differently and challenge the status quo, come and be a part of a dedicated team that’s investing in your future by shaping tomorrow today.

At PGIM, You Can!

What You Will Do
PGIM Real Estate's Originations team engages in all aspects of the commercial real estate lending process. As an Investment Associate on the Southeast Debt Originations  Team, you will help source, evaluate, structure, and execute multifamily and commercial real estate debt investments across PGIM's broad range of capital sources, including Core Debt, Core Plus Debt, High Yield, and Structured Debt strategies.
This position is based in Atlanta and is part of a fully integrated origination team responsible for more than $3 billion of annual production. The Investment Associate will work closely with senior originators, borrowers, intermediaries, and internal stakeholders throughout the transaction lifecycle, helping guide opportunities from initial screening through underwriting, approval, and closing. The successful candidate will play an active role in transaction execution while developing expertise across the full risk and return spectrum of commercial real estate lending strategies.

What You Can Expect
- Participate in all aspects of the loan origination and closing process, including underwriting, financial modeling, transaction structuring, pricing analysis, due diligence review, investment committee materials, negotiation, and closing.
- Evaluate opportunities across multiple strategies, including Core, Core Plus, High Yield, and Structured Debt executions.
- Prepare cash flow models, property valuations, borrower credit analyses, market research, sensitivity analyses, and investment memoranda.
- Assist in structuring and underwriting transactions to align with the investment objectives and risk parameters of PGIM's various capital sources.
- Coordinate with internal stakeholders, including Credit, Legal, Asset Management, Portfolio Management, and Closing teams to efficiently advance transactions through approval and closing.
- Review third-party reports, legal documentation, and due diligence materials as part of the transaction execution process.
- Interact with existing and prospective borrowers, intermediaries, attorneys, consultants, and other industry participants throughout the life of a transaction.
- Develop and maintain productive relationships with borrowers, intermediaries, attorneys, consultants, and other market participants to help facilitate transaction execution and long-term business growth.
- Develop market expertise across the Southeast region, including knowledge of local market dynamics, sponsors, capital providers, and investment opportunities.
- Review underwriting, financial models, and transaction materials prepared by Analysts and provide guidance, coaching, and developmental feedback to support their professional growth.
- Assist with training and mentoring Analysts and help ensure quality, consistency, and attention to detail across underwriting and transaction execution.
- Develop expertise in all PGIM systems necessary for the originations process, including Salesforce, Omnia, Loan Connect, and other internal platforms.

What You Will Bring
- Bachelor's degree in Finance, Economics, Real Estate, or a related field.
- 3-5 years of experience in commercial real estate lending, underwriting, banking, investments, capital markets, or a related field.
- Strong quantitative skills and demonstrated analytical ability.
- Demonstrated interest in commercial real estate finance and capital markets.
- A credit mindset and the ability to evaluate, structure, and underwrite loans while identifying and mitigating transaction risks.
- Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, with the ability to manage multiple transactions and competing priorities simultaneously.
- Outstanding written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills.
- Ability to work both independently and as an integral member of a team.
- Strong proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, including Excel, Word, PowerPoint, and Copilot.
- Ability to interact professionally with internal and external stakeholders, including originations, credit, legal, borrowers, brokers, developers, investors, and third-party service providers.
- Willingness to travel periodically for client meetings, property visits, and industry events.

*PGIM welcomes all applicants, even if you don't meet every requirement. If your skills align with the role, we encourage you to apply.

About PGIM Real Estate
With $207.9 billion in gross assets under management and administration ($133.8 billion net),1 PGIM Real Estate provides investors and borrowers access to a range of real estate equity, real estate debt, agriculture, and impact solutions across the risk-return spectrum.

PGIM Real Estate is a business of PGIM, the global asset management business of Prudential Financial, Inc. ( NYSE: PRU ). PGIM Real Estate’s risk management approach, execution capabilities and industry insights are backed by a 50-year legacy of investing in commercial real estate, a 140-year history of real estate financing,2 and the local experience of professionals in 32 cities globally. Through its investment, financing, asset management, and talent management approach, PGIM Real Estate engages in practices that strive to ignite positive environmental and social impact, while pursuing activities that seek to strengthen communities around the world. jobs.title: Reinsurance Finance Manager | PGIM Ireland
jobs.description:
This role can be based from our Letterkenny office (2 days onsite a week).

Prudential Financial Inc.’s (PFI) Bermuda Reinsurance team is seeking a skilled and highly motivated individual to fill a Manager, Reinsurance Operations role that will be based in Ireland and report to the Director, Reinsurance Operations, supporting the Bermuda based affiliate reinsurance companies, Gibraltar Reinsurance Company Ltd. (Gibraltar Re) and Lotus Reinsurance Company Ltd. (Lotus Re).

This role is ideal for a life reinsurance finance professional with 5+ years of experience, who is ready to play a key role in a newly formed operations function. You will initially support the design and lead the implementation of the operational framework, and then take responsibility for assigned business-as-usual activities, controls, documentation, issue resolution, and continuous improvement across the two reinsurance captives.
You will work closely with colleagues in actuarial, finance, legal and IT to ensure efficient and compliant operations across all stages of the reinsurance lifecycle — including treaty onboarding, transaction processing, reporting, and retrocession management. Strong Excel experience is key for this role.

Primary Responsibilities:
Build Phase
- Support the design and lead the implementation of core reinsurance and retrocession operational processes for the captives, including treaty onboarding, financial settlements, and reporting.
- Establish procedures, controls and documentation in line with internal standards.
- Collaborate with colleagues to define and implement infrastructure, data flows, and operating procedures that support internal reinsurance and third-party retrocession, including IT and data integration.
- Coordinate operational readiness for new treaties, amendments, system changes, and reporting requirements, including requirements documentation, testing, implementation tracking, and transition to business-as-usual ownership.
- Support the integration of operations with actuarial valuation, pricing, finance and risk management
- Participate in transaction negotiations related to operational arrangements and support the transition of negotiated transactions into sustainable processes.
- Develop clear working instructions and backup arrangements that promote operational continuity and reduce key-person dependency.

Steady-State Operations:
- Lead the ongoing administration of assigned reinsurance and retrocession arrangements, ensuring data accuracy, timeliness, control execution, and audit readiness.
- Coordinate the processing of internal reinsurance treaties and external retrocession activities, including settlements and operational follow-up with third-party reinsurers.
- Establish and perform reconciliations across treaty data, settlements, actuarial reporting, and financial reporting, and coordinate the investigation and resolution of discrepancies.
- Maintain effective day-to-day relationships with cedants, retrocessionaires, outsourced vendors, and service providers on operational matters, escalating material items when appropriate.
- Collaborate with internal teams on quarterly and annual reporting, financial close, actuarial valuation, and audit activities by providing complete, accurate, and timely operational information and evidence.
- Monitor operational issues, dependencies, and control concerns; coordinate timely resolution; and escalate material risks, delays, or decisions.
- Continuously evaluate and improve operational processes for scalability, efficiency, data quality, transparency, and risk control.
- Serve as a subject matter expert on assigned reinsurance operations and provide practical guidance to internal stakeholders.

Qualifications:
- Bachelor’s degree in business, actuarial science, finance, or a related discipline.
- Minimum 5+ years of experience in life insurance or reinsurance, ideally with exposure to both operational and technical aspects of treaty administration.
- Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and experience with database, reporting, and automation tools such as Microsoft Access, VBA, Power Query, or similar technologies.
- Knowledge of reinsurance structures, with specific understanding of internal reinsurance and retrocession to external parties.
- Demonstrated experience designing, implementing, or improving operational processes, especially in build-out or transformation environments.
- Experience or familiarity with supporting reinsurance operations within a regulated environment and an understanding of the control, documentation, and governance expectations applicable to long-term reinsurance operations.
- Strong organizational, project management, analytical, and problem-solving skills. Agile is a plus.
- Ability to work effectively in a lean team environment, combine strategic perspective with hands-on delivery, and manage multiple priorities.
- Demonstrated ability to prioritize and follow through on commitments, maintain strong attention to detail, and consistently deliver high-quality work within required timelines.
- Strong responsiveness and accountability, with a commitment to proactive communication, timely follow-up, and effective stakeholder management.
- Sound judgment in reviewing, validating, and challenging outputs, including those generated through automation or AI-enabled tools.
- Excellent interpersonal, verbal and written communication skills and ability to collaborate across functions and locations.

It’d be a plus if you had:
- Fellow or Associate of the Institute and Faculty of Actuaries or equivalent designation.
- Working knowledge of Bermuda Solvency Capital Requirement and/or Solvency II frameworks as they apply to long-term reinsurance operations.
- Experience with financial settlements, operational reconciliations, actuarial or financial reporting support, third-party retrocession, or outsourced service providers.
- Experience leveraging generative AI and other productivity tools to improve efficiency, automate routine activities, and enhance operational processes while maintaining appropriate human review and quality control.
- Python or similar programming experience, used to interrogate databases.
- Japanese language skill would be a plus.

* We know not everyone will meet 100% of the requirements, however we encourage you to apply if you think your skills are a good fit for this role.

- Competitive salary and established exam based increases: to attract and retain the best talent
- Culture: we are recognised within Prudential and more locally for our collaborative, supportive and friendly working environment, with state of the art offices

- Annual Leave starting at 23 days at full pay, plus 10 USA public holidays.

Working directly with senior investment professionals, this individual will evaluate bulk and flow purchases, resolve diligence findings, monitor post-purchase performance and support loan-level workout decisions.

This is an investor-side role rather than a traditional production-underwriting position. The successful candidate will assess each loan as an investment, distinguish curable exceptions from material credit or enforceability risks and exercise sound judgment when guidelines and documentation do not provide a mechanical answer.

This position follows a hybrid work model, with working 3 days in the Newark, NJ office and 2 days remotely. Remote work arrangements may be considered.

What you can expect
- Review DSCR, business-purpose, and Non-QM loans for compliance with acquisition guidelines, trade stips, and exceptions.
- Analyze borrower/guarantor credit (i.e., liquidity, reserves, ownership experience, etc.).
- Assess DSCR and property cash flow, including leases, rents, taxes, insurance, vacancy, and short-term rental assumptions.
- Evaluate collateral and valuation risk, including LTV/CLTV, appraisals, property condition, comparables, BPOs, AVMs, and valuation variances.
- Identify layered credit and collateral risks across leverage, purpose, cash-out, seasoning, loan size, property type, geography, reserves, experience, and documentation.
- Review title, insurance, closing and legal documents, and reconcile loan-tape data to source documentation for material discrepancies.
- Manage third-party due diligence, including vendor workflow, scope, findings, budget, documentation, and issue resolution.
- Evaluate and disposition exceptions and deficiencies through cures, compensating factors, waivers, structural protections, repricing, or loan removal.
- Provide investor recommendations and transaction execution, escalating material risks and managing pools through diligence, purchase, funding, and post-purchase review.
- Monitor asset performance and loss mitigation, evaluating delinquencies, servicing activity, workouts, foreclosure alternatives, recoveries, losses, and lessons learned to improve acquisition standards.

What you will do:
PGIM Real Estate Loan Services is seeking a Senior Asset Manager to join its FHA team.  The candidate will be responsible for independently managing a complex portfolio of FHA commercial real estate loans with minimal supervision.   The candidate must possess excellent writing, analytical and credit skills to assess and manage risk and produce decisive credit action recommendations. The candidate must also analyze and articulate watchlist comments and ensure loan covenant compliance.  With little supervision, the candidate must provide superior customer service, create efficiencies, and promote trust. The candidate shall possess good common sense, sound business judgment and will be dependable demonstrating a high level of integrity.  The candidate may be asked to guide and mentor junior asset managers in risk assessment, loan management and documentation.

What you can expect:
- Credit Actions: Perform cash flow analysis, market surveys, document review and other due diligence necessary to produce prompt, well written and supported case recommendations for complex borrower requests.  Transactions involve collateral properties located throughout the US. Borrower requests may include assumptions, modifications, partial releases, property substitutions, partial ownership transfers, lease approvals, easements, reserve disbursements, insurance losses, and property management & operator changes.
- Triggers:   Ensure loan covenant compliance requirements are managed timely and effectively including initial input, post-closing monitoring, maintenance of collateral, and debt service thresholds.
- Watch list:   Provide written analysis identifying key trends and issues noting any corresponding mitigants. Recognize broad implications of process and take initiative to improve quality of reporting and early detection of issues. Possess the ability to discuss relevant issues and provide remedies.
- Create Efficiencies: Attention to accurate detail, take initiative to continually improve the integrity of portfolio information and standardized reporting while ensuring the highest quality case recommendations and watchlist. Proactively identify and lead implementation of innovative and practical solutions.
- Collaboration:  Coordinates and works alongside loan originators, external counsel, government agency personnel, loan closers, peers, and third party vendors.

What you will bring:
- Bachelor’s degree required, preferably in Finance, Real Estate or related discipline.
- Strong understanding of commercial loan documents with varying degree of complexity.
- Solid understanding of the life of a commercial loan (loan closing to disposition of asset).
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills tailored to specific audiences
- Excellent interpersonal and customer service skills are essential including the ability to create, build and maintain relationships with internal and external parties.
- Proven analytical and problem-solving skills.
- Strong personal computer skills (Excel, Word, Outlook, Sharepoint, Power BI, etc.). with ability to quickly learn to work within proprietary systems.
- Strong organizational skills required with the ability to multi-task, work independently and as part of a team in a time sensitive environment where meeting established deadlines are critical.
- Candidate should have an open, creative and innovative mindset.

What will set you apart
- 7+ years of equivalent commercial real estate lending or asset management experience.
- Leadership mindset with the ability to take ownership and lead projects and/or efforts through various individual contributions across teams
- Strong ability to manage competing priorities
